group.name: How should recruited followers be protected?

plugin.name: Protected (recommended)
plugin.description:
Only the player can kill your followers. Anything else only knocks them down.
Vanilla bug: a very strong hit (common on Legendary difficulty) can bypass Protected and kill them anyway. Pick Essential if that bothers you.
You can change this later with iProtection in Data/SKSE/Plugins/ImmersiveRecruit.ini (1 = Protected, 2 = Essential).

plugin.name: Essential
plugin.description:
Nobody can kill your followers, not even you. They only get knocked down and get back up after combat. Not affected by the Protected bug on high difficulties.
NPCs that are already Essential stay Essential either way.
You can change this later with iProtection in Data/SKSE/Plugins/ImmersiveRecruit.ini (1 = Protected, 2 = Essential).
